testcase.system-out: Scenario: Select a source command without staging it from the Sketch panel ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software with Sketch1 being edited ✔ And a part document is in sketch edit in the MCAD Software ✔ And the ribbon shows the Sketch tab ✔ When the user opens the Create panel title context menu ✔ And the user chooses "Customize User Commands" ✔ Then the customization dialog opens on the "Ribbon" tab ✔ And the selected target is "Part | Sketch" ✔ And the source category is "All Commands" ✔ And the custom panel list is empty ✔ When the user selects "2D Sketches" in the available commands ✔ Then the "2D Sketches" row is highlighted ✔ And the right transfer button is enabled ✔ And the custom panel list remains empty ✔ And Apply and cancels remain disabled ✔ When the user clicks "Close" ✔ Then the customization dialog closes ✔ And no command is added to the custom panel ✔ And the sketch remains in edit mode
